mms_roles.Scientific use: Verify the primary and witness implementations before they carry answer-key authority.
Manufacture cases whose parameters, BCs, geometry and representation can be checked exactly through every adapter.
Manufacture fields with controlled divergence, residual, interface flux, stress or conservation properties to find numerical floors and implementation defects.
Generate exact synthetic pairs without a forward solve, as demonstrated for neural operators and extended by HyPINO and MML. [E6–E8]
Use prospectively generated MMS families to test implementation paths on hidden cases, while keeping physical target cases separate.

mms_factory.Required evidence: Symbolically derive all source, boundary and initial terms; retain expression and code-generation provenance.
Use multiple meshes/time steps and independently compute expected versus observed convergence.
Vary frequencies, amplitudes, couplings, coefficients, BC types and geometry maps within a registered MMS distribution.
Plant sign, index, coefficient, BC, coupling and unit defects under a blind protocol; measure whether the suite detects them.
Use controlled fields to qualify residuals, invariants, quadrature, interface balances and applicability rules.
Evaluate the same implementation on exact physical cases, converged independent cases and experiments where applicable.

mms_limits.Question: Can establish
mms_limits.Answer: Implementation consistency with the declared equations; observed order under refinement; BC/IC/source-term paths; coupled-term and constitutive implementation; measurement-operator floors; regression and mutation-test coverage.

mms_limits.Question: Cannot establish
mms_limits.Answer: That the governing model represents the physical system; that the manufactured forcing resembles the customer workload; that the target population is correct; that a closure model is adequate; that a product is safe, useful or qualified.

mms_limits.Question: Important Carbon caveat
mms_limits.Answer: MMS samples a solution family and induces a forcing/BC distribution. That induced distribution is not automatically the target engineering population P(x). Carbon must register it as a construction/verification population or qualify it as part of the Challenge.
